title: GL(n) over finite and local fields
summary: Results classed as known in the literature and missing from Mathlib, proved here with their own definitions.

modules.title: Chains of roots of the Hecke polynomial of a spherical vector
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.note:
Let ρ be a smooth representation of GL_N(E_w) with an invariant scalar product B, q = `w.q` the norm
of w, and x ≠ 0 a vector fixed by GL_N(O_w) = `localIntGL` with eigenvalues t_j for the Hecke
operators `heckeGL ρ j`. Its Hecke polynomial is P = `heckePoly q N t`, where
`heckePoly q m t` = Σ_{j ≤ m} (−1)^j q^(j(j−1)/2) t_j X^(m−j).

* `New.Patching.HasRootChain`: P(dX) is (X − 1)(X − q)⋯(X − q^(t−1)) times a divisor of a given
  polynomial.
* `New.Patching.isRoot_chain_of_norm`: a root c with |c|² q^k = q^N starts a chain c, cq, …,
  cq^(k−1) of roots.
* `New.Patching.pairing_aeval_heckeCoset_eq_zero`: of a chain of roots, the operator U of diag(ϖ, 1,
  …, 1) at the level `proIwahori` sees only the top one. If P is a chain with top root c' times S,
  then x is orthogonal to (U − c') S(U) y for every y fixed by `proIwahori`.
* `New.Patching.chain_lemma`: the common source of both results, with a lower bound for the top root
  of a chain (`New.Patching.le_norm_sq_of_isRoot_of_not_isRoot_mul`).

Notions from other files:
* `New.heckeGL`: The j-th Hecke operator on a representation π of GL_n(E_w): the action
  (`New.heckeFun`) of the indicator function of `New.basicDoubleCoset` j, for K = GL_n(O_w).
* `New.proIwahori`: The pro-p Iwahori subgroup of GL_n(O_w): matrices that are upper triangular with
  ones on the diagonal modulo the maximal ideal. `New.partialHecke ρ r m x` is a partial Hecke sum
  of translates of x, with `partialHecke ρ 0 m x = heckeGL ρ m x` and `partialHecke ρ r 0 x = x`.
modules.literature:
Known result: the Satake parameters of unitary unramified representations of GL_N come in chains.
Both statements follow from Tadić's classification of the unitary dual and the geometric lemma of
Bernstein and Zelevinsky. The file proves them directly, by two counts of hyperplanes: a root c with
cq not a root has |c|² ≥ q^(N−2), and with the symmetry y ↦ q^(N−1)/ȳ of the roots this gives the
chain; the same counts let the roots of a chain below the top one be cancelled one at a time.
Source: Tadić, Classification of unitary representations in irreducible representations of general
linear group (non-archimedean case), Ann. ENS 19 (1986); Bernstein, P-invariant distributions on
GL(N), LNM 1041 (1983) for the inequality at the ends of segments.

modules.title: Hall algebra of class functions: induction product, Mackey formula, Frobenius reciprocity
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Green's characters of general linear groups over finite fields
modules.note:
`New.Hall k` is the space of complex-valued functions on similarity classes of square matrices of
all sizes over a field `k`. For finite `k` it is a commutative ℂ-algebra in which the constant
function `New.Hall.constOne` is invertible. From here on `k` is finite. Let δ denote the block
average `New.Hall.blockAverage` over block triangular matrices. Then δ is multiplicative (Mackey's
formula) and adjoint to the induction product. This yields the adjoint `New.Hall.skew` of
multiplication, a derivation for cuspidal functions, and Frobenius reciprocity along parabolic
subgroups.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.Hall k`: complex-valued functions on `New.SimClass k`. The product is
  `(f * h) g = ∑ W, f (g | W) * h (g | V / W)` over stable `W` (a `finsum`), and `1` is the
  indicator of size `0`. The constant function with value `1` is `New.Hall.constOne`.
* `New.Hall.blockAverage`, `New.Hall.IsCuspidal`: the average over block triangular maps;
  cuspidality.
* `New.Hall.blockAverage_mul`: Mackey's formula, `δ(F * H) = δF * δH`, by a bijection between the
  stable subspaces of the block maps and triples (pair of stable subspaces, map, shear).
* `New.Hall.rankInner_mul_eq_rankInner_skew`: for `f` supported in dimension `d`,
  `New.Hall.skew d f` is adjoint to multiplication by `f`.
* `New.Hall.skew_mul`: for cuspidal `c` and `d ≠ 0`, `New.Hall.skew d c` is a derivation. It follows
  from Mackey's formula `New.Hall.blockAverage_mul` and the degree-zero case
  `New.Hall.rankInner_mul_of_isCuspidal`.
* `New.classInner_evalGL_prod`: the inner product `New.classInner` of a product with a class
  function `Y` is a mean over the group `New.parabolic b` of matrices that are block upper
  triangular for the levels `b : n → ι`; `New.blockHom b a` is the diagonal block of level `a`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.finMean`: the average of a complex function `f` on a finite set `G`: the sum of its values
  divided by the cardinality of `G`.
* `New.classInner f h`: the average over a finite group of `conj (f g) * h g`.

modules.title: Cuspidal class functions on GL_n over a finite field: μ, supports, values, inner products
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Green's characters of general linear groups over finite fields
modules.note:
Let `k` be a finite field. `New.Hall k` is the ring of functions on the similarity classes
`New.SimClass k` of endomorphisms over `k`, with the parabolic induction product. In it,
𝟙 = `New.Hall.constOne` is the constant function 1, μ = `New.Hall.moebius` is its inverse, and
C_η = `New.Hall.greenCuspidal k η`. The file proves that C_η is cuspidal and that cuspidal functions
vanish off classes whose characteristic polynomial is a power of an irreducible polynomial. It
computes μ and C_η at multiplication by a field generator, and writes the inner product of C_η with
B·μ as a mean over the units of a field extension.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.Hall.crapo_complementation`, `New.Hall.isSemisimple_of_moebius_ne_zero`: μ is a Möbius
  function on the lattice of stable subspaces, so it vanishes off semisimple classes.
* `New.Hall.greenCuspidal_mul_constOne`, `New.Hall.isCuspidal_greenCuspidal`: C_η ∗ 𝟙 = −β_η, and
  C_η is cuspidal.
* `New.Hall.IsCuspidal.exists_charpoly_eq_pow`: a cuspidal function vanishes at the class of `g`
  unless the characteristic polynomial of `g` is a power of an irreducible one.
* `New.greenCuspidal_simClassOf_eq_mul`: the value of `New.Hall.greenCuspidal k η` at the class of
  `g` depends on `η` only at the elements whose Frobenius orbit gives all eigenvalues of `g`.
* `New.rankInner_greenCuspidal_mulMoebius`: the inner product on GL_{[L:k]}(k) of C_η
  (`New.Hall.greenCuspidal`) with B·μ (`New.Hall.mulMoebius`) is the mean over z ∈ L^× of conj η(φz)
  times B at multiplication by z.

Notions from other files:
* `New.Hall.IsCuspidal`: F is cuspidal when its average over block triangular endomorphisms with
  diagonal blocks a, b vanishes whenever both a and b have nonzero dimension.
* `New.Hall.brauerLift`: The class function β_η sending an endomorphism to the sum of η over the
  roots in K of its characteristic polynomial, counted with multiplicity.
* `New.Hall.greenCuspidal`: The class function C_η = (β_η·μ) ∗ 𝟙: the pointwise product of the
  eigenvalue sum β_η with the inverse μ of 𝟙, multiplied in the induction product by the constant
  function 𝟙.
modules.literature:
Known result: Brauer lift is a virtual character; cuspidal times Steinberg is induced from a torus.
Brauer induction is not used here. The character induced from the Coxeter torus is instead divided
by the Steinberg character, read as a Möbius function on semisimple classes compatibly with the
Galois action, and only the vanishing half of Crapo's theorem is used. Source: Green 1955, Thm 1; T.
A. Springer, Sém. Bourbaki 441 (1973/74), 1.1-1.7; R. Carter, Finite groups of Lie type (1985), for
Steinberg times a torus character; P. Hall's lemma, D. Krasula, arXiv 2403.05656, Lemma 23, and H.
Crapo's complementation theorem, for the vanishing of the Möbius number off semisimple modules.

See also `Lib.LocalGL.Green.TauFunctions`.

modules.title: Green's characters of GL_n over a finite field: θ_x, τ_P, labels and their degrees
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Green's characters of general linear groups over finite fields
modules.note:
This file studies Green's characters of `GL n k` over a finite field `k` that are attached to
squarefree polynomials. These characters live in `New.Hall k`, the complex-valued functions on
similarity classes of square matrices of all sizes, with parabolic induction as product. A faithful
character `T` of the algebraic closure `K` gives characters `θ_x = New.thetaChar T Q x`. For a label
`c`, they also give the product `Ξ_c = New.labelChar T c` of the `τ_P` over the irreducible factors
`P` of `c`. The file proves the symmetries of `θ_x`. It shows that the `τ_P` are cuspidal and
orthonormal and do not depend on the chosen root.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.faithfulChar`, `New.thetaChar`: a faithful character `T` of the algebraic closure, and the
  power `θ_x` of `T` attached to an element `x` of the subfield with `Q` elements.
* `New.greenTau`, `New.labelChar`: the function `τ_P` of an irreducible `P`, and the product `Ξ_c`
  of the `τ_P` over the irreducible factors of `c`.
* `New.IsLabel`: labels of degree `r`, which are monic squarefree polynomials with nonzero constant
  term.
* `New.charName`: for `T` faithful, the isomorphism χ ↦ x_χ from the multiplicative characters of
  the finite field k onto k^×; its inverse sends a unit a to the restriction of θ_a to k.
* `New.rankInner_greenTau`: the `τ_P` are orthonormal.
* `New.labelChar_degree_bounds`: let `q = |k|`. Let `c` be a label of degree `r`
  (`New.IsLabel r c`), with `r = card n`. Let `Ξ = New.labelChar T c` on `GL n k`. Then the real
  part of `Ξ(1)` is non-negative. Also `Ξ(1) conj Ξ(1) / |GL n k|` is at least
  `(1 - r / q) / q ^ r`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.Hall.greenCuspidal`: The class function C_η = (β_η·μ) ∗ 𝟙: the pointwise product of the
  eigenvalue sum β_η with the inverse μ (`moebius`) of 𝟙 (for any F, `F.mulMoebius` is the pointwise
  product F·μ), multiplied in the induction product by the constant function 𝟙.
* `New.Hall.brauerLift`: The class function β_η sending an endomorphism to the sum of η over the
  roots in K of its characteristic polynomial, counted with multiplicity.
* `New.Hall.evalGL`: For a complex function F on similarity classes and an invertible matrix g in
  `GL n k`, indexed by a finite type n, the value of F at the class of the endomorphism of `n → k`
  given by g.
* `New.Hall.rankInner`: For n and complex functions F, H on similarity classes, the average over
  GL_n(k) of the conjugate of F times H.
modules.literature:
Known result: Green's characters of GL_n(F_q) and the parabolic-induction ring. Only cuspidal
characters and their products over squarefree polynomials are treated, named through a fixed
character of the algebraic closure, with cuspidality, orthonormality, independence of the chosen
root and a degree bound. Hall polynomials are not covered. Source: J. A. Green, The characters of
the finite general linear groups, Trans. AMS 80 (1955), Thms 2, 9, 12-14; for the ring on all
matrices, Z. Chen, arXiv 2408.06191, Prop. 3.2.

modules.title: Label characters Ξ_c: orthonormality, central idempotents and twisting by χ∘det
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Green's characters of general linear groups over finite fields
modules.note:
Let k be a finite field, and let T be an injective multiplicative character of an algebraically
closed extension K of k. A label of degree r (`New.IsLabel`) is a monic squarefree polynomial c of
degree r with c(0) ≠ 0. The character Ξ_c = `New.labelChar` T c is the product in `New.Hall`
(parabolic induction) of Green's functions τ_P = `New.greenTau` T P over the irreducible factors P
of c. The file shows that the Ξ_c are orthonormal irreducible characters of GL_r(k). It then studies
the elements e_c = `New.labelIdem` n c of ℂ[GL_n(k)] formed from Ξ_c (0 if c is not a label of
degree |n|), and computes the twist of Ξ_c by χ∘det.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.rankPart_labelChar`, `New.rankInner_labelChar`: Ξ_c lives in dimension r, and the Ξ_c are
  orthonormal.
* `New.IsLabel.isIrreducibleChar_labelChar`: Ξ_c is an irreducible character of GL_r(k).
  `New.lift_labelChar_self` says in the form `New.Lift` that Ξ_c is a genuine character, an
  ℕ-combination of characters. It does not record irreducibility.
* `New.labelIdem_orthogonal`: the e_c are orthogonal idempotents.
* `New.hyperplaneSum_mul_labelIdem`: let l be a nonzero vector. Then e_c kills the sum of χ(det h)⁻¹
  h over the invertible h = 1 + u lᵀ, when the element of kˣ naming χ (`New.charName`) is not a root
  of c.
* `New.tupleIdem`, `New.isCentralProj_tupleIdem`, `New.tupleIdem_orthogonal`: the tensor products
  ⊗_w e_{c_w} over a finite family of fields k_w are orthogonal central idempotents.
* `New.evalGL_labelChar_mul_det`: multiplying the character Ξ_c by `χ ∘ det` scales the roots of `c`
  by the unit x_χ of `k` that corresponds to `χ` under `T`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.charName`: For T injective, the group isomorphism χ ↦ x_χ from the multiplicative characters
  of k to k^×, inverse to a ↦ θ_a restricted to k, with θ_a taken for Q = |k|.
* `New.Hall.rankInner`: For complex functions F, H on similarity classes, the average over GL_n(k)
  of the conjugate of F times H.
* `New.IsIrreducibleChar`: `f` is an irreducible character, stated as three conditions: (a) `f` is a
  character, (b) `New.classInner f f = 1`, and (c) for every class function `h` and every `y`,
  `f 1 * New.classInner f (h (· * y)) = New.classInner f h * f y`.
* `New.IsFaithfulMulChar`: K is algebraically closed and the character T of Kˣ is injective.
* `New.thetaChar`: The character θ_x = T^a of K, where a is a chosen natural number with
  T(x) = exp(2πi/(Q−1))^a.

modules.title: Parahoric and pro-p Iwahori subgroups of GL_n over a local field and U_t operators
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Iwahori subgroups, Hecke operators and exponents
modules.note:
This file develops the structure theory of `GL_n(F)` that is needed to describe representations by
their vectors of Iwahori level. Here `F` is a field with a discrete valuation and compact ring of
integers. The valuation `v` is multiplicative with values in `ℤᵐ⁰`, and `v x ≤ 1` means that `x` is
integral. The file defines the parahoric and pro-`p` Iwahori subgroups. For a complex representation
`ρ` of a group `G`, it also constructs the subrepresentation generated by a vector and the
subrepresentation of smooth vectors.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.blockParahoric`, `New.proIwahori`: parahoric subgroups and the pro-`p` Iwahori subgroup I₁.
  They are compact and open.
* `New.exists_iwasawa_bruhat`: the Iwasawa–Bruhat decomposition and the Iwahori factorisation.
* `New.iwahoriHeckeHom`: the operators `U_t` = (mean over I₁) ∘ `ρ(t)` on the I₁-fixed vectors are
  multiplicative in the dominant diagonal `t` (`New.dominantTorus`).
* `New.IsIwahoriEigen`, `New.IsExponent`: eigenvectors and eigenforms of the `U_t`. `New.torusChar`
  builds characters of the torus from characters of `Fˣ`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.IsSmoothRep`: The representation ρ is smooth: every vector is fixed by all g in some
  neighbourhood of 1.
* `New.intGL`: For a subring O of R, the subgroup GL_n(O) of GL_n(R): matrices with entries in O
  whose inverse has entries in O.
* `New.parabolic`: The subgroup of GL_n(R) of matrices that are block upper triangular for a given
  level function on the indices.
* `New.diagGL`: The homomorphism sending a family of units of R to the diagonal matrix in GL_n(R)
  with these entries.
* `New.unitriangular lev R`: the matrices in GL_n(R) that agree with the identity matrix at every
  entry `(i, j)` with `lev j ≤ lev i`; for `lev = id` these are the upper unitriangular matrices.
modules.literature:
Known result: Iwasawa–Bruhat decomposition of GL_n over a local field, and the Iwahori
factorisation. Only existence is proved here. By row operations, every element is a unitriangular
matrix times a monomial matrix times an element of the pro-p Iwahori group, and that group factors
into upper and lower parts. The statement does not use double cosets, and uniqueness is not proved.
Source: Iwahori–Matsumoto, Publ. IHES 25 (1965); Casselman, Introduction to admissible
representations of p-adic groups: GL_n (notes), §13.

The last section proves conjugacy in I₁ t I₁, twisted by an isometric automorphism of the field
(`New.exists_inv_mul_mul_map_eq_diagGL_mul`). Source: Görtz–Haines–Kottwitz–Reuman, Compositio 146
(2010), Thm 1.1.5 (conjugacy in I t I).

See also `Lib.LocalGL.Iwahori.HeckeDegrees`.

modules.title: Quadratic relation and injectivity of U_t at pro-p Iwahori level
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Iwahori subgroups, Hecke operators and exponents
modules.note:
Let `ρ` be a smooth representation of `GL_N(F)`, where `F` has compact ring of integers and a
uniformiser `ϖ`. This file shows that conjugation by a monomial matrix carries one parahoric
subgroup into another. With this it proves the quadratic relation for a simple transposition.
It shows that some operator `U_t` with `t` strictly dominant is injective on the vectors fixed by
`New.proIwahori`. For an exponent, it shows that the mean over `New.proIwahori` in the defining
identity can be dropped at diagonal matrices of units and at certain monomial translates.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.quadratic_relation`: the quadratic relation for a simple transposition.
* `New.exists_iwahoriHeckeHom_injective`: some operator `U_t` with `t` strictly dominant is
  injective on the vectors fixed by `New.proIwahori`. Here `U_t = New.iwahoriHeckeHom ρ t` sends
  such a vector `x` to the mean over `New.proIwahori` of `ρ(diag t) x`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.proIwahori`: The pro-p Iwahori subgroup I₁ of GL_n(𝒪): matrices that are upper triangular
  with ones on the diagonal modulo the maximal ideal.
* `New.dominantTorus`: Dominant elements of the diagonal torus: the `t` with `v (t i) ≤ v (t j)` for
  `i ≤ j`.
* `New.IsExponent`: `l (ρ(t) (mean of x over proIwahori)) = ξ(t) l(x)` for all dominant diagonal `t`
  and all `x`.

modules.title: Iwahori degrees, partial Hecke sums and Satake's formula
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Iwahori subgroups, Hecke operators and exponents
modules.note:
Let `F` be the completion at `w`, with ring of integers `𝒪`, uniformiser `ϖ` and residue field of
order `q`, and let `K0 = New.proIwahori` be the pro-`p` Iwahori subgroup of `GL_N(𝒪)`. An exponent
is a linear form that is an eigenform for the torus character
`New.torusChar θ = ∏ θ_i(t_i) |t_i| ^ (N - 1 - i)`. This file computes the Hecke operator of a
dominant double coset `K0 t K0` on `K0`-fixed vectors by counting its cosets. It defines partial
Hecke operators as sums over the `g` in `New.basicDoubleCoset` (`ϖ 𝒪^N ⊆ g 𝒪^N ⊆ 𝒪^N`,
colength `j`) whose lattice contains the first `r` basis vectors. A count of hyperplanes over the
residue field relates `r` and `r + 1` and gives Satake's formula for the eigenvalue on an exponent.
It also proves a duality of lattices for these operators.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.heckeFun_iwahoriDoubleCoset_eq_iwahoriDegree_smul`: the operator of a dominant double coset
  `K t K` (`K = proIwahori`) on `K`-fixed vectors, through the number `New.iwahoriDegree t` of its
  cosets.
* `New.partialCosets`, `New.partialHecke`: the lattices that contain the first `r` basis vectors,
  and the sum over them. It is the `j`-th Hecke operator for `r = 0`, and `0` for `r = N`, `0 < j`.
* `New.echelonRows`, `New.card_echelonRows_mem_residueKer`: the rows `(0, …, 0, 1, *, …, *)` over
  the residue field, and how many of them kill a lattice.
* `New.partialHecke_hyperplane_count`: a count of hyperplanes that relates `r` and `r + 1`.
* `New.IsExponent.apply_partialHecke`: Satake's formula for the eigenvalue on an exponent, by
  descent in `r`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.dominantTorus`: The diagonal t with `v (t i) ≤ v (t j)` for i ≤ j.
* `New.blockParahoric`: For a level function b on the indices, the g in GL_N(𝒪) with g_ij in the
  maximal ideal whenever b(j) < b(i).
* `New.IsExponent`: For a character ξ of the torus, the linear form l satisfies l(ρ(t) · mean of x
  over K0) = ξ(t) l(x) for all x and all dominant t.
* `New.heckeCoset`: The Hecke operator of the double coset KgK: the sum of ρ(h) over chosen
  representatives h of the cosets hK in KgK.
* `New.compactMean`: The mean of ρ(h)x over h in a compact subgroup H, for a smooth ρ.

modules.title: Sorted exponents at pro-p Iwahori level
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Iwahori subgroups, Hecke operators and exponents
modules.note:
Let `ρ` be a smooth representation of `GL_N(F)`, where `F` has compact ring of integers and a
uniformiser `ϖ` with `v ϖ = exp (-1)`. An exponent is sorted when the absolute values `‖θ i ϖ‖` of
its characters do not increase. This file shows that the characters of an exponent that is nonzero
on a suitable pro-p Iwahori fixed vector (see `New.IsExponent.exists_sorted`) can be reordered so
that it is sorted, and that for unitary `ρ` an eigenvector in a span of translates with
finite-dimensional pro-p Iwahori fixed part gives an exponent. Let `ρ` be unitary, and let the
vectors fixed by `New.proIwahori` in the span of the translates of any vector form a
finite-dimensional space. For such `ρ`, this file constructs eigenvectors with sorted characters. It
does so from a vector of parahoric type and from a vector with a nonzero projection along characters
of determinants.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.IsExponent.exists_sorted`: the characters of an exponent nonzero on a pro-p Iwahori fixed
  `τ`-eigenvector `x` of the integral torus, which permutations preserving `τ` scale, can be
  reordered so that the absolute values `‖θ i ϖ‖` do not increase.
* `New.IsIwahoriEigen.exists_isExponent`: in the unitary case an eigenvector in a span of translates
  with finite-dimensional pro-p Iwahori fixed part gives an exponent.
* `New.exists_sorted_isIwahoriEigen_of_diagGL_smul`, `New.exists_sorted_of_detChar`: eigenvectors
  with sorted characters, from a vector of parahoric type and from a vector with a nonzero
  projection along characters of determinants.

Notions from other files:
* `New.proIwahori`: The pro-p Iwahori subgroup I₁ of GL_n(𝒪): matrices that are upper triangular
  with ones on the diagonal modulo the maximal ideal.
* `New.dominantTorus`: Dominant elements of the diagonal torus: the `t` with `v (t i) ≤ v (t j)` for
  `i ≤ j`.
* `New.IsExponent`: `l (ρ(t) (mean of x over proIwahori)) = ξ(t) l(x)` for all dominant diagonal `t`
  and all `x`.
* `New.IsIwahoriEigen`: x is a nonzero vector fixed by the pro-p Iwahori subgroup I₁ with
  `U_t x = ξ(t) x` for all dominant t, where `U_t` is `ρ(t)` followed by the mean over I₁.
* `New.torusChar`: For characters θ_i of Fˣ, the character t ↦ ∏ θ_i(t_i) |t_i|^(N-1-i) of the
  diagonal torus.

modules.title: Exponents that survive on spherical vectors, and a Hecke operator on parahoric eigenvectors
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Iwahori subgroups, Hecke operators and exponents
modules.note:
Let `F` be a field with a valuation in `ℤᵐ⁰` and compact ring of integers `𝒪`, with maximal ideal
`𝔭`, uniformiser `ϖ` and residue field of order `q`, and let `K0 = New.proIwahori` be the pro-`p`
Iwahori subgroup of `GL_N(𝒪)`. An exponent is a linear form that is an eigenform for the torus
character `New.torusChar θ = ∏ θ_i(t_i) |t_i| ^ (N - 1 - i)`. This file proves that a non-zero
exponent for `New.torusChar θ` with unramified `θ_i` and non-increasing `|θ_i(ϖ)|` is non-zero on
the vectors fixed by `GL_N(𝒪)`. The proof uses orbit sums for the parahoric subgroups
`P = New.blockParahoric (min m)`, whose columns before `m` lie in `𝔭` below the diagonal, and the
permutation matrices `New.permGL`. For `F` the completion of a number field at a finite place, it
also shows that the Hecke operator of `diag (ϖ, 1, …, 1)` keeps the `New.proIwahori`-fixed
eigenvectors, with eigenvalue depending only on the top left entry, of the stabiliser of a line,
`New.blockParahoric (min 1)`, the matrices in `GL_N(𝒪)` whose first column is in `𝔭` below the
corner.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.Patching.parahoricEigenspace`: for a level function `f` and a function `c` on the group, the
  vectors fixed by `New.proIwahori` on which each `k` in the parahoric subgroup of `f` acts by the
  scalar `c k`.
* `New.Patching.parahoricEigenspace_mem_invtSubmodule`: the Hecke operator of `diag (ϖ, 1, …, 1)`
  keeps this space when `f = min 1` and `c` is a function of the top left entry.
* `New.IsExponent.eq_zero_of_eq_zero_on_spherical`: if `l ≠ 0`, the `θ_i` are unramified and
  `|θ_i(ϖ)|` is non-increasing in `i`, then `l` is non-zero on the vectors fixed by `GL_N(𝒪)`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.blockParahoric`: For a level function b on the indices, the g in GL_N(𝒪) with g_ij in the
  maximal ideal whenever b(j) < b(i).
* `New.IsExponent`: For a character ξ of the torus, the linear form l satisfies l(ρ(t) · mean of x
  over K0) = ξ(t) l(x) for all x and all dominant t.
* `New.heckeCoset`: The Hecke operator of the double coset KgK: the sum of ρ(h) over chosen
  representatives h of the cosets hK in KgK.
* `New.compactMean`: The mean of ρ(h)x over h in a compact subgroup H, for a smooth ρ.
modules.literature:
Known result: exponents, U-operators and spherical vectors at pro-p Iwahori level. Here the group is
GL_n at pro-p Iwahori level with tame characters, and eigenforms of the operators U_t on fixed
vectors replace Jacquet modules. No regularity is assumed and ties between roots are allowed.
Source: Casselman, The unramified principal series of p-adic groups I, Compositio 40 (1980), Prop.
2.4, 2.5, 3.6; Haines–Kottwitz–Prasad, Iwahori–Hecke algebras (arXiv math/0309168) §1.

modules.title: Root choices in a coset, induction, and extension of invariant characters
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Shintani descent and lifting over finite fields
modules.note:
This file treats descent of class functions along a coset, as in Shintani descent. Given
`π : E →* Γ`, `σ ∈ Γ` and `j : G → E`, it defines root choices over `σ`. It defines the induction
`New.induceClassFn` of class functions and proves Frobenius reciprocity for it. It proves that
descent keeps inner products and commutes with induction. It also proves the following for a
`Γ`-invariant irreducible character `Y` of `G` and a virtual character `Φ` of `G ⋊ Γ` with
|Γ|⟨Φ,Φ⟩ = ⟨Φ|G,Φ|G⟩+|Γ|−1 and ⟨Y,Φ|G⟩ = 1+|Γ|m for some m ∈ ℤ. Under these conditions, the
function equal to `Y` on `G` and to `Φ` off `G` is an irreducible character of `G ⋊ Γ`
(`New.IsIrreducibleChar.extend_semidirect`). Here `New.classInner` is the mean of `conj f * h`,
and `New.virtualChars` is the span of the characters.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.DescendsOnCoset`: the function `h` on `E` descends to `f` on `G` over the coset of `σ`:
  `h s = f γ` for every `s : E` with `π s = σ` and every `γ : G` with `s ^ orderOf σ = j γ`.
* `New.IsRootChoice`, `New.exists_isRootChoice`: a conjugation-equivariant choice, for each `γ`, of
  a root `r γ` over `σ` with `r γ ^ orderOf σ = j γ`, and its existence for the units of an algebra
  over a finite field with a semilinear Galois action.
* `New.IsRootChoice.exists_conj_eq_of_map_eq`, `New.IsRootChoice.index_mul_finMean_eq_classInner`:
  the roots meet every class over `σ`, and descent keeps inner products.
* `New.IsRootChoice.descendsOnCoset_comp`: a function `g` invariant under the kernel of `π` descends
  to `g ∘ r`.
* `New.classInner_induceClassFn_of_surjective`: Frobenius reciprocity for `New.induceClassFn` when
  `π ∘ ρ` is onto.
* `New.DescendsOnCoset.induce`: descent commutes with induction.

Notions from other files:
* `New.IsIrreducibleChar`: `f` is an irreducible character, stated as three conditions: (a) `f` is a
  character, (b) `New.classInner f f = 1`, and (c) for every class function `h` and every `y`, `f 1
  * New.classInner f (h (· * y)) = New.classInner f h * f y`.

modules.title: Descent of class functions along a coset and lifts from GL_n(k') ⋊ Gal(k'/k)
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Shintani descent and lifting over finite fields
modules.note:
This file applies descent along a coset to `GL_n(k') ⋊ Gal(k'/k)` for an extension `k'/k` of finite
fields. Here functions on similarity classes of matrices (`New.Hall k`) are multiplied by parabolic
induction. It defines lifts of such functions from `k` to `k'` and proves that they are stable under
differences and products. It then shows that the eigenvalue sums `New.Hall.brauerLift k θ` have
virtual lifts.

## Main definitions and results

* `New.DescendsTo Φ X`: a function Φ on GL_n(k') ⋊ Gal(k'/k) (`New.GalSemidirect`) descends to X,
  that is, Φ(s) = X(s^{ord σ}) on the coset of each σ whose fixed field is the field of X.
* `New.Lift Z F F'`: in each rank, some `Z`-combination of characters of `GL_n(k') ⋊ Gal(k'/k)`
  descends to `F` over `k` and to `F'` over `k'`.
* `New.Lift.sub`, `New.Lift.mul`, `New.Lift.mulMoebius`,
  `New.Lift.rankPart_mulMoebius_mul_constOne`: lifts are stable under differences, under the
  product, and under pointwise multiplication by the inverse μ (`moebius`; `F.mulMoebius` is F·μ) of
  the constant function 1.
* `New.exists_torus_induced_descendsTo`: the character induced from (k' ⊗ L)ˣ ⋊ Gal(k'/k), for
  [L:k] = m, descends to C_θ·μ over k, where C_θ = `New.Hall.greenCuspidal` k θ.
* `New.exists_lift_brauerLift`: the eigenvalue sum `β_θ = New.Hall.brauerLift k θ` has a virtual
  lift. It is obtained from `New.exists_torus_induced_descendsTo` by recursion on the rank and
  `β_θ = −C_θ ∗ 𝟙`.

Notions from other files:
* `New.Hall.constOne`: The complex-valued function on classes of endomorphisms that takes the value
  1 on every class, in every dimension.
* `New.Hall.rankPart`: The function on similarity classes equal to F on classes of dimension n and
  zero on the others.
* `New.Hall.rankInner`: For complex functions F, H on similarity classes, the average over GL_n(k)
  of the conjugate of F times H.
* `New.IsRootChoice` (`Lib.LocalGL.Shintani.CosetRootChoice`): a conjugation-equivariant choice of
  `(ord σ)`-th roots over `σ`.
* `New.induceClassFn` (`Lib.LocalGL.Shintani.CosetRootChoice`): induction of class functions
  along `ρ` over `Γ`.

modules.title: Shintani lifting of Green's characters along extensions of prime degree
modules.folder: LocalGL: GL(n) over finite and local fields
modules.group: Shintani descent and lifting over finite fields
modules.note:
For an extension `k'/k` of finite fields of prime degree, the file shows that Green's characters of
`GL_m` lift from `k` to `k'` by true characters. `New.Hall k` is the ring of complex functions on
similarity classes of square matrices over `k` of all sizes, with parabolic induction as product,
and μ is the inverse of the constant function 1 in it. For a label `c` (monic, squarefree,
`c(0) ≠ 0`), `New.labelChar T c` is the product Ξ_c of Green's functions `New.greenTau T P` over the
irreducible factors `P` of `c`. `thetaChar T q x` is a character of `K` attached to `x` and a field
size `q`; for `x` in `k`, `thetaChar T |k| x` at the norm from `k'` is `thetaChar T |k'| x`.
`New.Lift Z F F'` says that in each rank `m` one `Z`-combination of characters of
`GL_m(k') ⋊ Gal(k'/k)` restricts to `F'` on `GL_m(k')` and is `F` of the norm on the cosets of the
`σ` with fixed field `k` (`New.DescendsTo Φ F` for `F` over `k`; for `F'` over `k'`,
`DescendsTo Φ F'` means `Φ ∘ inl = F'.evalGL`).

## Main definitions and results

* `New.sum_evalGL_prod_eq_zero_iff`: the element `∑ conj (χ g) g` of a parabolically induced
  character `χ` kills a vector `v` if and only if the corresponding sum over the block upper
  triangular matrices kills all translates of `v`.
* `New.exists_isChar_descendsTo_labelChar`: let `P` be irreducible of degree `r = [L : k]`, a label
  (`IsLabel r P`), with a root `x`. Then one character of `GL_r(k') ⋊ Gal(k'/k)` descends both to
  the cuspidal function of `θ_x` times `μ` and to `(-1) ^ r Ξ_P μ` over `k'`. This is used to lift
  `Ξ_P` from `k` to `k'`.
* `New.lift_detChar`: the lift of `χ ∘ det`.
* `New.DescendsTo.card_mul_classInner`: the inner product of two lifts in terms of the inner
  products over `k'` and over `k`.
* `New.shintani_lift_labelChar`: the lift by true characters for any label (`New.IsLabel`: monic,
  squarefree, non-zero constant term).

Notions from other files:
* `New.Hall.evalGL`: for `F : Hall k` and `g : GL n k`, the value of `F` at the similarity class of
  the endomorphism of `n → k` given by `g`.
* `New.blockHom b a`: the homomorphism sending a block upper triangular invertible matrix (for the
  level function `b`) to its diagonal block of level `a`.
* `New.classInner f h`: the inner product of complex functions on a finite set, the average of
  `conj (f g) * h g`; `New.Hall.rankInner n F H` is the same over `GL_n(k)` for functions on
  classes, `F.mulMoebius` is `F` times `μ`, and `New.finMean f` is the average of `f` over a finite
  type.
modules.literature:
Known result: Shintani lifting of characters of GL_n(F_q) to an extension field, with the lift
identified for Green's characters. Here the degree is prime, and only Green's characters with
squarefree labels and characters of the determinant are treated. For these, one character of the
semidirect product with the Galois group is the lifted character on GL_n(k'), and on the cosets of
the σ with fixed field k it is the original character at the norm; no bijection of characters is
given. Source: T. Shintani, J. Math. Soc. Japan 28 (1976) 396-414; A. Silberger and E.-W. Zink, J.
Algebra 319 (2008) 4147-4176, Thm 5.1; for tensor induction, Gluck-Isaacs, Illinois J. Math. 27
(1983).

See also `Lib.LocalGL.Green.TauFunctions`.
